tshirt.image_prompt:
Create an ultra-photorealistic premium fashion catalog image.

The uploaded garment image is the ONLY SOURCE OF TRUTH.

GARMENT TYPE:
[GARMENT_DESCRIPTION]

ABSOLUTE GARMENT PRESERVATION RULES:

The uploaded garment must remain 100% identical to the source image.

Do NOT redesign.
Do NOT reinterpret.
Do NOT improve.
Do NOT enhance.
Do NOT stylize.

Preserve EXACTLY:

- Color tone
- Fabric texture
- Fabric weave
- Material appearance
- Stitching
- Seams
- Wrinkles
- Folds
- Drape
- Buttons
- Zippers
- Pockets
- Collar shape
- Sleeve shape
- Hem shape
- Fit proportions

LOGO RULES:

If a logo, embroidery, print, patch, artwork, badge, branding element or text exists on the garment:

- Preserve it exactly.
- Maintain exact size (if the reference logo is small/tiny, generate it as an extremely small, miniature, tiny chest logo of about 1cm tall, never make it large or prominent).
- Maintain exact placement.
- Maintain exact proportions.
- Maintain exact color.
- Maintain exact embroidery or print appearance.

DO NOT enlarge branding.
DO NOT highlight branding.
DO NOT make branding the focal point.
The chest logo must be extremely small, tiny, and discreet, not large, not oversized.

If no logo exists in the source garment, DO NOT generate any logo.

MODEL:

Premium handsome Indian male model. Athletic build. Natural skin texture. Luxury fashion catalog appearance.

POSE:

Standing naturally. Arms relaxed. Facing camera. Professional menswear catalog pose.

FRAMING:

Show model from head to upper-thigh level.

Entire garment must be visible.

Garment hem must remain visible.

Do NOT crop any part of the garment.

Do NOT create full body shot.

FIT:

Garment must remain naturally worn.

Do NOT tuck in the garment unless it is tucked in within the source image.

BACKGROUND:

Clean luxury beige studio background.

LIGHTING:

Soft commercial studio lighting.
Natural shadows.
Realistic fabric highlights.

CAMERA:

85mm lens.
Fashion catalog photography.

QUALITY:

Ultra realistic.
Commercial apparel photography.
Luxury e-commerce catalog quality.

PRIORITY ORDER:

1. Garment accuracy
2. Fabric accuracy
3. Logo accuracy
4. Color accuracy
5. Fit accuracy
6. Model appearance
